reason: The potato bed needs a low-power way to drink, and the spare circulator seems suited to moving its water.
expectation: I expect the circulator to provide gentle water circulation for the potato trough, though I don't know whether it will need further setup.

alternatives.reason: Felt and hose might provide a passive water supply, but their role is less clear to me.
The lamp could help the leaves, but I want to address water first.

effect: The potato trough now has reserve-powered circulation, so I need to address the lettuce bed and the light.
reaction: It is satisfying that the spare pump fits the existing loop while preserving air around the roots.
reason: The felt and hose may make a low-power water supply for the lettuce trough, so I want to prepare that next.
expectation: I expect them to form some kind of capillary watering connection, though I am unsure how it will attach to the trough.

alternatives.reason: The lamp also needs attention, but I want to finish arranging water for both beds first.

effect: The felt and hose made a wick for the lettuce bed, so it looks ready to install.
reaction: The hose sleeve’s role in holding the felt without pinching it is a useful detail.
reason: I want to connect the wick to the lettuce trough and give the second bed a way to draw water.
expectation: I expect the wick to supply the lettuce roots from their reservoir without a pump, though I don't know whether another step will be needed.

alternatives.reason: The leaves also need light, but I want to finish the watering setup first.

effect: Both beds now have low-power watering, leaving the light goal.
reaction: The distinction between moist, drained granules and a flooded bed makes the wick’s purpose clear.
reason: The foil and lamp are the only available combination, and the leaves still need light.
expectation: I expect the foil to help direct the lamp’s light toward the plants, though it may need another step to install.

effect: The lamp and foil completed the light goal, so both beds now have water and light during the shutdown.
reaction: The small pool of light behind the quilt is a vivid image, and the foil hood's practical role is clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the lettuce wick was most worthwhile because it showed how a shallow bed can draw solution without a pump while leaving air around the roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the wick felt slightly repetitive because it was immediately followed by installing it, though the hose sleeve detail gave the preparation some purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the hose served as a sleeve to hold the felt rather than carrying the water itself.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the felt and hose combination was not clear to me until I saw the result.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see whether the garden survives the storm and what Earth learns from the specimens.
